rationale: Identity verification was done correctly via name+zip, and actions targeted the correct account. However, the agent performed order-changing writes (cancelling two pending orders and initiating a return) without first explicitly stating the exact changes and obtaining the user’s confirmation, which the policy requires. The agent also asserted order statuses (“two pending, one delivered”) without tool-supported status fields. Later, the agent provided precise refund totals that are not supported by any tool output and claimed all refunds (including cancellations) would go to PayPal, which is unsupported and likely incorrect since cancellations typically refund to the original payment method. These issues constitute acting without required confirmation and providing fabricated/unsupported information, failing the pass criteria.
